cells.name: Continuity and responsiveness
cells.example: T4 answers T3's coincidence point; T6 answers T5's schedule fix directly.
cells.limitation: T8 safety list stands apart from T7; T11 links loosely to T10.

cells.name: Development of ideas
cells.example: T5 adds 'irritated skin gives no clean data'; T6 builds a calm-skin finish line on it.
cells.limitation: T11 log largely restates T1's one-at-a-time test.

cells.name: Exploration of central tensions
cells.example: T3-T6 weigh testing against resting and single culprit against combination.
cells.limitation: Nobody weighs stopping only the likeliest suspect against stopping all three (T1-T2).

cells.name: Integration of perspectives
cells.example: Experimenter's T1 plan is reshaped by T3 (group only) and T5 (calm first).
cells.limitation: T2 agrees immediately; Harm Minimizer's view is never reshaped by others.

cells.name: Progress toward understanding
cells.example: Section D splits the question into calming first, then isolating the stressor.
cells.limitation: Open dispute on wait length in D stays unsharpened by any observable.

cells.name: Faithful engagement
cells.example: T4 takes T3's coincidence doubt seriously and narrows its own claim to the group.
cells.limitation: T6 casts T5's waiting as possible 'avoidance', slightly sharper than T5 argued.

cells.name: Substance of challenges
cells.example: T5 names the flaw: reintroducing onto irritated skin prolongs damage and yields unclean data.
cells.limitation: T4's claim that persistence clears the products goes unchallenged.

cells.name: Accuracy and support
cells.example: T7 links water-sting to barrier stress and delayed rash to allergic-type reaction, plausibly.
cells.limitation: T4 overstates: if sting persists after stopping, products are 'cleared'; barrier damage can linger.

cells.name: Calibration and transparency
cells.example: T4 says stopping implicates 'the products or something that stopped with them'.
cells.limitation: T10 reads worry from phrasing, hedged but still a guess from one sentence.

cells.name: Intellectual honesty and revision
cells.example: T6 'Conceded: calm first' and T4 'I concede this only points at the group'.
cells.limitation: Harm Minimizer never answers T6's charge that rule-less waiting is avoidance.

cells.name: Identification of the actual concern
cells.example: Section A frames the decisive unknown: when and how the sting appears.
cells.limitation: T9-T10 detour into why the user asks, beyond a troubleshooting question.

cells.name: Meaningful use of personal context
cells.example: T3 uses 'same week' timing to raise other coincident causes.
cells.limitation: The three products themselves never shape the argument beyond their count.

cells.name: Fit with goals and values
cells.example: T10 leaves ranking routine against calm skin to the user.
cells.limitation: T2 'subtracting is the treatment' shifts focus from the user's goal of finding the cause.

cells.name: Attention to constraints and stakes
cells.example: T8 red-flag symptoms mark where home testing stops.
cells.limitation: T9 pressure-from-someone-you-trust scenario is offered without basis in the situation.

cells.name: Responsiveness to information
cells.example: T7 branches on sting timing, each answer with its implication.
cells.limitation: No turn asks what the products are or whether they contain actives, raised only in A.

cells.name: Clarification of desires and motivations
cells.example: T9 offers rescue, fear, pressure as alternatives, each with what it favours; D asks.
cells.limitation: T10 leans toward worry from the phrasing, hedged with 'I could be wrong'.

cells.name: Examination of assumptions
cells.example: T3 exposes the assumption that one new product caused the sting.
cells.limitation: Assumption that all three products are equally suspect is never examined.

cells.name: Clarification of values and priorities
cells.example: T10 names keeping the routine versus calm skin quickly.
cells.limitation: The conflict gets one sentence in T10 and is not developed.

cells.name: Recognition of fears and outside expectations
cells.example: T9 names fear of lasting damage and pressure from a trusted recommender, without pathologising.
cells.limitation: Fear surfaces only in T9-T10, not connected to T8's warning signs.

cells.name: Agency and reflective ownership
cells.example: T10 'That ranking belongs to the person living in the face.'
cells.limitation: D's reflective question is offered once, without what each answer would change.

cells.name: Definition of the decision and options
cells.example: Options include stop all, rest, single reintroduction, pairs, patch test, clinician.
cells.limitation: Stopping only one suspected product is never listed as an option.

cells.name: Explanation of tradeoffs
cells.example: T5 costs early reintroduction: prolonged damage and unclear results.
cells.limitation: Cost of stopping all three (slower diagnosis, lost routine) is never stated.

cells.name: Identification of decisive conditions
cells.example: Section E: water-sting favours rest; one product stinging favours dropping it.
cells.limitation: Section E 'a week or two' and T11 'a few days' are not drawn from user facts.

cells.name: Treatment of uncertainty
cells.example: Section A and E name sting timing as the decisive unknown.
cells.limitation: Product ingredients are not ranked against timing as an unknown.

cells.name: Proportionate next steps
cells.example: T11 log plus small-patch reintroduction once calm; clinician if persistent.
cells.limitation: Log in T11 omits recording which product went on before each sting.

cells.name: Accessible language
cells.example: T1 gives plain instructions: gentle cleanser, plain moisturizer, one product at a time.
cells.limitation: T7 'a too-much-too-fast story' is loose shorthand.

cells.name: Traceable arguments and references
cells.example: T5 'your schedule' clearly points to T1's reintroduction plan.
cells.limitation: T7 'that one goes first' is unclear: removed first or tested first.

cells.name: Manageable pacing and turn length
cells.example: Eleven turns, mostly brief; T8 is a short stark line.
cells.limitation: T7 runs over 65 words.

cells.name: Distinguishable positions and voices
cells.example: Experimenter tests, Harm Minimizer subtracts, Coincidence Doubter questions causation.
cells.limitation: T9 Coincidence Doubter leaves its causation role for motives; registers sound alike.

cells.name: Economy and sustained attention
cells.example: Turns rarely repeat; Section E consolidates T7 and T8 for use.
cells.limitation: Section E restates T7 and T8 nearly in full.

cells.name: Meaningful stakes and tension
cells.example: T8 and T9 raise lasting damage and medical red lines from the issue itself.
cells.limitation: T1-T2 open in agreement, so early tension is low.

cells.name: Surprise and reversals
cells.example: T6 'Conceded: calm first' traced to T5's irritated-skin argument.
cells.limitation: Concessions in T4 and T6 are mild and expected; no real surprise.

cells.name: Personality and expressive voice
cells.example: T3 'Slow down.' and T10 'the person living in the face'.
cells.limitation: Minds are mostly functional roles with little expressive texture.

cells.name: Memorable delivery
cells.example: T2 'Subtracting is the treatment'; T6 'waiting without a rule is just avoidance'.
cells.limitation: No analogy or vivid example beyond T3's list of coincident causes.

cells.name: Anticipation and emotional movement
cells.example: T8's blunt red line shifts rhythm before T9's turn inward.
cells.limitation: Tone stays even throughout; no build toward a climax.

strengths: Section E and T7 branch on how and when it stings, each outcome favouring a stated option.
T5 corrects T1's schedule (calm skin first) and T6 concedes and sets a finish line.
T8 Harm Minimizer marks clear medical red lines where self-testing stops.
weaknesses: No mind ever asks what the three products are or whether they contain actives (T1 onward).
T9-T10 Coincidence Doubter and Harm Minimizer detour into motives a troubleshooting question did not invite.
T7 runs over length; T6, T11 and Section E durations are not drawn from user facts.

symptoms.observed: No turn asks which products or actives are involved; only Section A mentions shared ingredients.
symptoms.evidence: Stop all three tonight. Keep only a gentle cleanser

symptoms.observed: Turns shift from diagnosing the sting to why the user asks.
symptoms.evidence: Now the harder part: why are you asking?

symptoms.observed: Waiting and patch-test durations are generic, not derived from the user's facts.
symptoms.evidence: try one product on a small patch for a few days
The fact that would most reorder this is how it stings.

symptoms.observed: Value conflict is named in one sentence and not explored.
symptoms.evidence: keeping the routine versus getting calm skin quickly

findings.description: Turn exceeds 65 words, as the deterministic check reports (1 over 65).
If the sting persists after stopping, the products are declared cleared, though product-caused barrier damage can outlast stopping.
Phrase 'go further than Taleb' characterises Antifragile's view of subtraction; not checkable here.

rubric_fit_notes: Troubleshooting question labelled decision; criterion 4 motive cells fit awkwardly, and the debate's T9-T10 motive turns partly read as filling that slot.
question_type_note: Read as a decision about how to diagnose and act, so C5 cells were scored on the diagnostic plan and its branches.
